fortune.linePrev: While it burns right through my stomach

fortune.line: I'd like to do a song about fate called "There But for Fortune"
stanza: I'd like to do a song about fate called "There But for Fortune"
A song written for me by Miss Joan Baez

fortune.songTitle: Pretty Maids All in a Row
fortune.line: And all you wishing well fools with your fortunes
stanza: And all you wishing well fools with your fortunes
Someone should send you a rose
With love from a friend, it's nice to hear from you again
And the storybook comes to a close
Gone are the ribbons and bows
Things to remember, places to go
Pretty maids all in a row

fortune.line: So I take my good fortune
fortune.linePrev: Everybody's got something good to say
fortune.lineNext: And I fantasize of our leaving

misfortune.line: And think upon your own misfortune
stanza: Go home, go home to your father's garden
Go home and weep your fill
And think upon your own misfortune
Which you bought with your wanton will
